BrochureContent.Content:
This impressive 4 bed, 5 bathroom dormer type detached bungalow extends to approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and occupies a generous 2.2 acre site, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary design, space and privacy. Located just 3 km from Lough Scur, Keshcarrigan Lough and the picturesque waterside village of Keshcarrigan, home to the renowned Gertie's Bar, the property enjoys an enviable rural setting while remaining within easy reach of local amenities. Designed with modern family living in mind, the bright and spacious interior features four bedrooms and four bathrooms, an impressive internal balcony, vaulted ceiling and mezzanine floor, while floor-to-apex glazing floods the main living area with natural light and provides a stunning focal point around the centrally positioned gas fireplace. The accommodation further benefits from a separate sitting room, a superb open-plan kitchen/living/dining area and a separate utility room. Energy efficiency is well catered for with a B-rated energy performance, geothermal underfloor heating and PVC double glazing throughout. A home office and fibre broadband is available for those seeking to work from home in a country side setting. Externally, the property is approached via a tarmac driveway and has generous tarmac parking apron, complemented by a detached garage and carport, making this an outstanding home for those seeking contemporary living in a beautiful lakeland setting.
